metadata.title: Simulating the socioecology of virtual primates using B3GET: a generalized behavioral modeling tool
metadata.description: Understanding how individual behaviors scale up to population and ecosystem patterns remains a central challenge in ecology. Here, we introduce B3GET (Behavior, Ecology, Genetics, Evolution, and Tradeoffs), a generalized agent-based modeling framework that links individual stimulus–response rules to emergent ecological, evolutionary, and social dynamics. Stimuli include the observable traits of individuals, such as their sex, age, and fertility status, among other phenotypes and signals; responses include movement, body growth, and inclination to mate, eat, fight, and perform other behaviors. These rules are heritable and can mutate and recombine during sexual reproduction, resulting in the emergence of adaptive strategies and counterstrategies. We conducted 288 simulations totaling 370,199 individuals, divided equally among four emulated primate species: chimpanzees, geladas, hamadryas baboons, and olive baboons. We demonstrate that (1) B3GET can generate patchy and homogeneous virtual plant food environments; (2) virtual organisms can live and thrive in these habitats and persist for generations; (3) populations can evolve over generations; and (4) these virtual primate counterparts resembled the target species in terms of their dispersal patterns, mating strategies, and ranging behaviors. B3GET users can edit the starting files to create species-specific virtual organisms and collect simulation data for testing hypotheses. Because B3GET can emulate a broad range of animal species, it provides a promising approach for investigating broader questions in animal behavior and primate socioecology, both for research and education.

metadata.title: Platanus occidentalis: High-Resolution Scans of Leaves (IFML Dataset 2101)
metadata.description:
Abstract: This dataset contains high-resolution flatbed scans of Platanus occidentalis (American Sycamore) collected in Story County, Iowa, USA. These images were generated as part of the Iowa Forestry Media Library (IFML).

Specimen Details

  • Taxon: Platanus occidentalis
  • Family: Platanaceae
  • Common Name: American Sycamore
  • Specimen Type: Leaf (Adaxial & Abaxial)
  • Collection Date: 2025-07-31
  • Location: Story County, Iowa, USA

Data Structure

To facilitate both scientific analysis and general use, this dataset is organized into two distinct packages:

  • Archival Package (.zip): Contains the raw, uncompressed 48-bit TIFF masters captured at 1200 dpi. These files are cropped to the specimen boundaries and contain no color grading, post-processing, or physical scale bars. Recommended for high-magnification analysis of venation and pubescence.
  • Access Package (.zip): Contains processed, color-corrected images. This includes PNGs with backgrounds removed (transparent) and high-quality JPEGs sharpened for immediate use in presentations, teaching materials, and web applications.

Technical Specifications

  • Scanner: Epson Expression 13000XL
  • Resolution: 1200 dpi
  • Color Depth: 48-bit Color (TIFF) / 24-bit (JPEG/PNG)
  • Processing: Archival TIFFs are raw crops. Access files were processed in Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom using a standardized white balance and editing script to ensure consistency across the library.

Citation & Attribution

Under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license (CC-BY 4.0), you are free to use these images but must provide appropriate credit.

  • For Academic Research (Bibliography): Willard, Eli. (2026). Iowa Forestry Media Library: Platanus occidentalis Dataset 2101. Zenodo.
  • For Web, Social Media, or Presentations (Caption/Credit Line): "Image courtesy of Eli Willard / Iowa Forestry Media Library (CC-BY 4.0)"

  • Archival Package (.zip): Contains the raw, uncompressed 48-bit TIFF masters captured at 1200 dpi. These files are cropped to the specimen boundaries and contain no color grading, post-processing, or physical scale bars. Recommended for high-magnification analysis of venation and pubescence.
  • Access Package (.zip): Contains processed, color-corrected images. This includes PNGs with backgrounds removed (transparent) and high-quality JPEGs sharpened for immediate use in presentations, teaching materials, and web applications.

Technical Specifications

  • Scanner: Epson Expression 13000XL
  • Resolution: 1200 dpi
  • Color Depth: 48-bit Color (TIFF) / 24-bit (JPEG/PNG)
  • Processing: Archival TIFFs are raw crops. Access files were processed in Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom using a standardized white balance and editing script to ensure consistency across the library.
